# DeepRouter

> One API key for many models (Claude, Qwen, GLM, DeepSeek, Kimi and more) behind one
> OpenAI-, Anthropic- and Gemini-compatible gateway. Point the tool you already use at
> DeepRouter by changing two things: a base URL and an API key.

## Read this first

The base URL is NOT the same for every tool. Pick by the protocol the tool speaks, and
watch the three tools that append the version segment themselves:

- OpenAI protocol: `https://api.deeprouter.co/v1`  (POST /chat/completions, `Authorization: Bearer sk-...`)
- Anthropic protocol: `https://api.deeprouter.co`  (POST /v1/messages, `x-api-key: sk-...`)
- Gemini protocol: `https://api.deeprouter.co/v1beta`  (POST /v1beta/models/<model>:generateContent, `x-goog-api-key: sk-...`)
- HOST ONLY (the tool adds the version segment): Cherry Studio, NextChat, Gemini CLI -> `https://api.deeprouter.co`

Adding the version segment when the tool already does gives a doubled path and a
`404 Invalid URL` whose message does not name the cause.

Every guide below starts with a machine-readable `Facts for AI assistants` block
holding the exact base URL, endpoint, auth header and model for that tool.
Append `.zh.md` instead of `.md` for the Chinese version of any guide.

## Guides

### AI coding assistants (terminal)

- [Claude Code](https://deeprouter.co/docs/integrations/claude-code.md): Two env vars and Claude Code routes through DeepRouter.
- [Codex CLI](https://deeprouter.co/docs/integrations/codex.md): Add a DeepRouter model provider in config.toml.
- [Gemini CLI](https://deeprouter.co/docs/integrations/gemini-cli.md): Point Google’s CLI at the DeepRouter Gemini endpoint.
- [OpenCode](https://deeprouter.co/docs/integrations/opencode.md): A custom OpenAI-compatible provider in opencode.json.

### Code editors & extensions

- [Cursor](https://deeprouter.co/docs/integrations/cursor.md): Override the OpenAI base URL in Cursor settings.
- [GitHub Copilot](https://deeprouter.co/docs/integrations/copilot.md): Bring your own key via an OpenAI-compatible provider.
- [Cline (VS Code)](https://deeprouter.co/docs/integrations/cline.md): OpenAI-compatible or Anthropic provider in Cline.
- [Zed](https://deeprouter.co/docs/integrations/zed.md): A custom OpenAI-compatible model in settings.json.

### Desktop & chat apps

- [Claude Cowork](https://deeprouter.co/docs/integrations/claude-coworks.md): Set the gateway in developer mode.
- [OpenClaw](https://deeprouter.co/docs/integrations/openclaw.md): A provider block in openclaw.json.
- [Cherry Studio](https://deeprouter.co/docs/integrations/cherry-studio.md): Add an OpenAI provider with the DeepRouter host.
- [BotGem](https://deeprouter.co/docs/integrations/botgem.md): An OpenAI-compatible service provider.
- [Chatbox](https://deeprouter.co/docs/integrations/chatbox.md): OpenAI API Compatible provider with the DeepRouter host.
- [LobeChat](https://deeprouter.co/docs/integrations/lobehub.md): Set the OpenAI API proxy address to DeepRouter.
- [OpenCat](https://deeprouter.co/docs/integrations/opencat.md): Add a custom API provider with the DeepRouter host.
- [NextChat](https://deeprouter.co/docs/integrations/nextchat.md): Custom endpoint + key, or self-host env vars.
- [WorkBuddy](https://deeprouter.co/docs/integrations/workbuddy.md): A custom model entry pointing at DeepRouter.

### Helpers, SDKs & frameworks

- [CC Switch](https://deeprouter.co/docs/integrations/cc-switch.md): A point-and-click provider switcher for Claude Code.
- [OpenAI SDK](https://deeprouter.co/docs/integrations/openai-sdk.md): Set base_url to DeepRouter in Python or Node.
- [LangChain](https://deeprouter.co/docs/integrations/langchain.md): ChatOpenAI / ChatAnthropic pointed at DeepRouter.
- [LlamaIndex](https://deeprouter.co/docs/integrations/llamaindex.md): OpenAILike with the DeepRouter base URL.

### Browser & other

- [Immersive Translate](https://deeprouter.co/docs/integrations/immersive-translate.md): A custom OpenAI-compatible translation service.
- [Any other tool](https://deeprouter.co/docs/integrations/others.md): The universal rule for any tool with a base URL field.

## Optional

- [The complete guide](https://deeprouter.co/docs/integrations/GUIDE.md): the whole idea explained once - key, base URL, verify.
- [Any other tool](https://deeprouter.co/docs/integrations/others.md): what to do when a tool has no base-URL setting.
- [Console](https://deeprouter.co): sign in, get a key, browse the Model Catalog.
